entry.title: Hoyo de Monterrey Le Hoyo Du Maire — Single
experienceTags: Occasion: Short premium smoke, afternoon smoke, Cuban comparison
entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, cream, toasted nuts, light coffee and floral sweetness are the projected centre of this slender Le Hoyo. The Index rates the exact cigar at 2/5 strength, so it is deliberately being scored for refinement rather than intensity. Its handmade 4″ × 30 Entreactos format should deliver more nuance and a cleaner progression than a machine-made club, while the narrow ring still rewards patient pacing.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. The Index currently lists the single at A$28.40 and the box of 25 as sold out. Strength and Quality are provisional and Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
